reasoning: Let Z(n) = number of trailing zeros of n! = sum_{i>=1} floor(n/5^i). Z is nondecreasing and increases only when n passes a multiple of 5: going from 5m-1 to 5m, Z jumps by v5(5m) = 1 + v5(m). Hence exactly v5(m) values of k are skipped at n = 5m, and every value Z(5m) is attained. Compute Z(40010) = 8002 + 1600 + 320 + 64 + 12 + 2 = 10000, so k = 10000 is attained and the attained values in 1..10000 are exactly Z(5), Z(10), ..., Z(40010), i.e. m = 1..8002 gives 8002 distinct attained values. Skipped k <= 10000 = 10000 - 8002 = 1998. Cross-check via the recurrence: skipped count = sum_{m=1}^{8002} v5(m) = floor(8002/5) + floor(8002/25) + floor(8002/125) + floor(8002/625) + floor(8002/3125) = 1600 + 320 + 64 + 12 + 2 = 1998.
